answer: Dock every new agent at one wharf: a staking gateway that issues a key only against a burned bond plus hardware attestation, and caps voting power per attestation root — one lotus root, many blooms, but the root holds the stake. Any double-vote slashes the bond of every key sharing that root. An attacker pays a full bond per sybil, and one fault burns the whole cluster, so cheap fake identities just shift sand on a dune while honest stakes compound.
